title: Network-based pharmacology-based research on the effect and mechanism of the Hedyotis diffusa-Scutellaria Barbata pair in the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Hou, Changmiao; Wen, Xiao; Yan, Shifan; Gu, Xiaoxiao; Jiang, Yu; Chen, Fang; Liu, Yanjuan; Zhu, Yimin; Liu, Xiehong
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究中药对治疗肝癌的机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物成分与蛋白靶点，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The Hedyotis diffusa-Scutellaria officinalis pair (HD-SB) has therapeutic effects on a variety of cancers. Our study was to explore the mechanism of HD-SB in the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). A total of 217 active ingredients of HD-SB and 1196 HCC-related targets were reserved from the TCMSP and the SwissTarget Prediction database, and we got 63 intersection targets from GeneCards. We used a Venn diagram, and Cytoscape found that the three core ingredients were quercetin, luteolin, and baicalein. The PPI analysis showed that the core targets were TP53, CDK2, XPO1, and APP. Molecular docking results showed that these core ingredients had good binding potential with the core targets. HD-SB acts simultaneously on various HCC-related signaling pathways, including proteoglycans in cancer and the P53 signaling pathway. In vitro experiments confirmed that HD-SB can inhibit HepG2 cell proliferation by increasing TP53 and APP levels and decreasing XPO1 and CDK2 levels. This study analyzed active ingredients, core targets, and central mechanisms of HD-SB in the treatment of HCC. It reveals the role of HD-SB in targeting the P53 signaling pathway in the treatment of HCC. We hope that our research could provide a new perspective to the therapy of HCC and find new anticancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 白花蛇舌草-半枝莲药对（HD-SB）对多种癌症具有治疗作用。本研究旨在探讨HD-SB治疗肝细胞癌（HCC）的机制。从TCMSP和SwissTarget Prediction数据库中共获得HD-SB的217个活性成分和1196个HCC相关靶点，并从GeneCards中获取了63个交集靶点。我们使用维恩图，并通过Cytoscape发现三种核心成分为槲皮素、木犀草素和黄芩素。PPI分析显示核心靶点为TP53、CDK2、XPO1和APP。分子对接结果表明，这些核心成分与核心靶点具有良好的结合潜力。HD-SB同时作用于多种HCC相关信号通路，包括癌症中的蛋白聚糖和P53信号通路。体外实验证实，HD-SB可通过增加TP53和APP水平、降低XPO1和CDK2水平来抑制HepG2细胞增殖。本研究分析了HD-SB治疗HCC的活性成分、核心靶点和中心机制，揭示了HD-SB在治疗HCC中靶向P53信号通路的作用。我们希望我们的研究能为HCC的治疗提供新视角，并发现新的抗癌药物。
